_about: XENO STORE community save index (SPEC §17.22.1). Rows are added by .github/workflows/saves-intake.yml from save-submission issues; status is pending until the XENO team adds the approved label. Consoles show status published only — pending, rejected and example rows are never listed. The three entries below are examples of the record shape (status example) and are ignored by the app.
